Toosen Jordan!

■ Stage Direction
Age: 30s
Personality: Strict

★ Request
Outfit specification: Casual wear

I mean, at my place, my mom gets on my case so hard that I'd never get to eat stuff like this.
Wait, hang on, isn't that gel nail art totally slaying?! What's the occasion?
Who's the star today, huh?

So cheap! You're so cute, honestly~
Don't go changing on us even when you head off to Tracen Academy, Jordan.
Once a month is way off! It was like once every two months, tops!

Yeah. Honestly, it's gonna be kinda lonely. Without Jordan around,
our regular squad is pretty much done, right? ...Couldn't you just bail on enrolling? Like, right now.

Still, looks like she hasn't totally given up yet. She was running side-by-side
in voluntary training yesterday too. ...Though it seems that time off took a toll.

Is she off her game... or is she just kinda phoning it in?
She's trailing way behind everyone else, though...
Who's making your heart throb?

Mmm, thanks.
...Well, yeah, I guess. I'll do my best.
(Ding-dong♪)

(—Today I'm winning. For real.
Seriously, it's about time... I have to win.)
Feeling a faint curiosity, I cast my gaze toward the racetrack.
Talk about an insane gear shift.

Whether she heard the surrounding whispers or not, Tosen Jordan bolted off.
Something about her caught my attention, and before I knew it, I was following after her.

No way I'm changing! ...Well, but since you went through all the trouble to get in,
give it your all, okay? We're all rooting for you~.
Any closing words?

(...No good, something's off!
Usually I can dig in way harder, so why—)
...*pant*, *pant*! Dammit!
*Inhale*... *exhale*...! —Alright!

Hey, look, it's Tosen Jordan. Did her hoof injury heal up?
I heard she wasn't in any shape to run, though.

Hey, cut that out, seriously! I put in crazy effort for real~
Got praised by a teacher for the first time in my life, too. He was all, "Not bad at all."
(What is this, I feel so floaty...?! I gotta dig in harder!)

In stark contrast to her airy running, the raw feelings she cried into the hollow of that great tree were unmistakable—
and for a while, the contradictory image of her refused to leave my mind.

(Stay focused out of the gate and grab a good position.
From there... keep my head clear so my pace doesn't get messed up—)

Well, but I get why the teacher'd say that.
You're seriously way too clumsy, or maybe just way too dumb.

Right~? 1,500 yen for first-timers, isn't that insane? It's basically budget-brand cheap.
They gave me a friend coupon, so you can have it. A present for getting into school.
Damn it, damn it, damn it, damn it, damn it, daaaaamnnn itttt~~~!
Over there, y'know. I kinda feel like maybe I could pull it off, too~.

Like throwing away your report card by mistake, or accidentally burning the Sports Day banner
along with other trash... Weren't you writing apology letters pretty much every month?

She's supposedly healed up, but there's a strong chance it'll flare up again.
Even now, it seems like she keeps having relapses over and over...

...Hmm, wonder what's up. Did her spirit finally break?
She was working so hard up until yesterday, though... I hope she's alright.
Ayyy, thanksss~☆
Whoa, that legitimately makes me happy.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

Tosen Jordan's oddly sluggish running stood out for all the wrong reasons...
and she crossed the finish line far behind the pack.
*pant*, *pant*... ...*ugh*.

When I went to watch the mock races to scout for a trainee Umamusume,
it seemed that one girl was on everyone's lips.

Now rounding the fourth corner, the leader enters the final stretch!
The field is strung out in a single file!

Alright, UmaTok video done~. I'll post it later.
Let's eat burgers, eat, eat, eeat!

A few weeks after that.
Rumors began to spread that Tosen Jordan had started avoiding races.
—A few months later.
Now, all runners are in the gate—and they're off!
...Dammit...!
